_설명: 『月に帰った契約社員』 썸네일 A/B용 애니메이션 HD(2560x1440, seedream v4 edit, 4장 약 0.12달러). 제0장 8: 영상은 실사, 썸네일만 일본 드라마 만화풍. 구도: 왼쪽 무릎 꿇고 애원하는 鷲尾(스포트라이트) · 오른쪽 크게 담담히 서 있는 光(竹とんぼ) · 뒤 보름달·붉은 모니터. 글자는 로컬 합성(make_thumbnails).
_style_preset: Semi-realistic Japanese webtoon illustration, crisp bold ink outlines, detailed cel shading, ultra sharp, 16:9

characters.prompt: Create ONE single ultra-sharp, highly detailed illustration in 16:9 widescreen for a YouTube thumbnail — one image only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders. Art style exactly like reference image 4 but cleaner and sharper: semi-realistic Japanese webtoon / drama-manga illustration, crisp bold black ink outlines, detailed cel shading with soft gradients, glossy highlights, rich saturated colors, strong rim light, every face crisp and in focus. Setting: a corporate boardroom at night after a blackout — a huge full moon glowing through the tall windows behind, a wall of monitors glowing solid red, glossy dark table, red emergency light on the floor. Composition (keep exactly): RIGHT THIRD, LARGE — the young man from reference image 1 (26, slim, short black hair with long bangs, small mole under his left eye, NO glasses, plain light-grey work jacket, a white towel around his neck) standing calm and dignified, seen from the chest up, his face big and sharp at about one third from the right edge in the upper half of the frame, looking down with quiet composed eyes, holding a small hand-made bamboo dragonfly toy at his chest. LEFT-CENTER, in a white spotlight on the floor — the heavy executive from reference image 2 (59, greying slicked-back hair, thin round gold-rimmed glasses, dark navy double-breasted suit, red tie, gold watch) on his knees begging with clasped hands raised, face wet with tears and sweat, mouth open in despair, glasses askew, as in reference image 3. Far background: a few faceless office workers in dark suits watching in shock, softly out of focus. Leave the LEFT edge and the TOP-LEFT area relatively simple (dark) for large text to be added later; keep the bottom-right corner empty of faces. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. Negative: grid, collage, panels, borders, blurry, extra fingers, deformed eyes, duplicate people, realistic photo, 3D avatar, chibi.
